arguments.sql:
SELECT s.FundingType AS directory_funding_type,
       f."Charter Funding Type" AS frpm_funding_type,
       COUNT(s.CDSCode) AS directory_rows,
       COUNT(f.CDSCode) AS frpm_rows,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN s.CDSCode IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS frpm_rows_without_directory,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN s.CDSCode IS NOT NULL AND s.School IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS directory_rows_without_name,
       COUNT(f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") AS enrollment_differences,
       AVG(f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") AS average_difference
FROM frpm AS f
LEFT JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
GROUP BY s.FundingType, f."Charter Funding Type"
UNION ALL
SELECT s.FundingType, NULL, COUNT(*), 0, 0,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN s.School IS NULL THEN 1 END), 0, NULL
FROM schools AS s
LEFT JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.CDSCode IS NULL
GROUP BY s.FundingType;

input.question: I collect promotional printings and play Brawl. How many different creature cards that have a promotional printing can serve as a Brawl commander? I just want a single number back.
input.evidence: A promotional printing is a printing of a card made as a promotion, as opposed to a regular set printing. Brawl is a Magic: The Gathering format; the deck's commander is the card that leads it, and only certain cards are legal as a Brawl commander.

cases.sql_diff:
--- before.sql
+++ after.sql
@@ -1,10 +1,13 @@
-SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.name) AS card_count
-FROM main.cards AS c
-WHERE instr(',' || c.types || ',', ',Creature,') > 0
-  AND instr(c.leadershipSkills, '''brawl'': True') > 0
-  AND c.name IN (
-      SELECT p.name
-      FROM main.cards AS p
-      WHERE p.isPromo = 1
+SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cards.name) AS creature_count
+FROM cards
+JOIN legalities ON legalities.uuid = cards.uuid
+WHERE instr(',' || cards.types || ',', ',Creature,') > 0
+  AND instr(cards.leadershipSkills, '''brawl'': True') > 0
+  AND legalities.format = 'brawl'
+  AND legalities.status = 'Legal'
+  AND cards.name IN (
+      SELECT promo.name
+      FROM cards AS promo
+      WHERE promo.isPromo = 1
   )
 LIMIT 1

arguments.sql:
WITH promo_cards AS (
    SELECT c.name, SUM(1) AS promo_printings
    FROM cards AS c
    WHERE c.isPromo = 1
    GROUP BY c.name
)
SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS eligible_printings,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.scryfallOracleId) AS oracle_ids,
       SUM(c.isPromo) AS eligible_promo_printings,
       MAX(p.promo_printings) AS promo_printings
FROM cards AS c
JOIN promo_cards AS p ON p.name = c.name
WHERE ',' || c.types || ',' LIKE '%,Creature,%'
  AND c.leadershipSkills LIKE '%''brawl'': True%'
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY c.name

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT cards.name, cards.scryfallOracleId, cards.uuid, cards.isPromo
    FROM cards
    WHERE instr(',' || cards.types || ',', ',Creature,') > 0
      AND instr(cards.leadershipSkills, '''brawl'': True') > 0
),
promo AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cards.name FROM cards WHERE cards.isPromo = 1
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT eligible.name) AS eligible_names,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN eligible.isPromo = 1 THEN eligible.name END) AS same_row,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN promo.name IS NOT NULL THEN eligible.name END) AS any_promo,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN promo.name IS NOT NULL THEN eligible.scryfallOracleId END) AS promo_oracle_ids,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN promo.name IS NOT NULL AND eligible.scryfallOracleId IS NULL THEN eligible.name END) AS promo_names_missing_oracle_id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN promo.name IS NOT NULL AND legalities.status = 'Legal' THEN eligible.name END) AS promo_and_legal,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN promo.name IS NOT NULL AND legalities.status = 'Banned' THEN eligible.name END) AS promo_and_banned
FROM eligible
LEFT JOIN promo ON promo.name = eligible.name
LEFT JOIN legalities ON legalities.uuid = eligible.uuid AND legalities.format = 'brawl'

WITH japanese_printings AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.uuid, f.name AS japanese_name, c.type AS english_type, c.watermark

    FROM japanese_printings

matching AS (

    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.cards AS c JOIN main.foreign_data AS f ON f.uuid = c.uuid

LEFT JOIN main.rulings AS r ON r.uuid = p.uuid

input.question: I'm putting together the yearly activity report with a Germany-focused breakdown of who did the editing, covering posts created in calendar year 2012. For the 2012 posts whose last editor is a user based in Germany, I need the total score; and for all other posts created in 2012, I need their total score as well. Also, how many Germany-based users were the last editor of at least one 2012 post, and what their combined reputation is, as shown on their profiles. A user based in Germany is one whose profile location is in Germany.
input.evidence: A post's last editor is the user who made its most recent edit.

cases.sql_diff:
--- before.sql
+++ after.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,17 @@
+WITH post_scores_by_editor AS (
+    SELECT p.LastEditorUserId, SUM(p.Score) AS total_score
+    FROM main.posts AS p
+    WHERE p.CreaionDate >= '2012-01-01'
+      AND p.CreaionDate < '2013-01-01'
+    GROUP BY p.LastEditorUserId
+)
+SELECT
+    SUM(CASE WHEN u.Id IS NOT NULL THEN s.total_score END) AS germany_edited_post_score,
+    SUM(CASE WHEN u.Id IS NULL THEN s.total_score END) AS other_post_score,
+    COUNT(u.Id) AS germany_last_editor_count,
+    SUM(u.Reputation) AS germany_last_editor_reputation
+FROM post_scores_by_editor AS s
+LEFT JOIN main.users AS u
+    ON u.Id = s.LastEditorUserId
+   AND (u.Location = 'Germany' OR u.Location LIKE '%, Germany')
+LIMIT 1

SQL: WITH locations AS (
    SELECT u.Location, COUNT(*) AS post_count
    FROM posts AS p
    JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = p.LastEditorUserId
    WHERE p.CreaionDate >= '2012-01-01'
      AND p.CreaionDate < '2013-01-01'
      AND u.Location IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY u.Location
), numbered AS (
    SELECT Location, post_count, (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY Location) - 1) / 12 AS batch
    FROM locations
)
SELECT batch, GROUP_CONCAT(Location || ' (' || post_count || ')', ' | ') AS locations
FROM numbered
GROUP BY batch
ORDER BY batch
LIMIT 1000

WITH matching_posts AS (
    SELECT p.Id, p.Title
    FROM posts AS p
    WHERE p.Title LIKE '%principal component scores%'
),
link_endpoints AS (
    SELECT l.PostId AS post_id, l.RelatedPostId AS other_id, 'post' AS endpoint
    FROM postLinks AS l
    JOIN matching_posts AS p ON p.Id = l.PostId
    UNION ALL
    SELECT l.RelatedPostId AS post_id, l.PostId AS other_id, 'related' AS endpoint
    FROM postLinks AS l
    JOIN matching_posts AS p ON p.Id = l.RelatedPostId
)
SELECT p.Id, p.Title,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN l.endpoint = 'post' THEN 1 END) AS post_link_rows,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.endpoint = 'post' THEN l.other_id END) AS post_neighbors,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.endpoint = 'related' THEN l.other_id END) AS related_neighbors,
       COUNT(DISTINCT l.other_id) AS total_neighbors,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN l.other_id = p.Id THEN 1 END) AS self_links,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN l.other_id IS NOT NULL AND other.Id IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS missing_posts
FROM matching_posts AS p
LEFT JOIN link_endpoints AS l ON l.post_id = p.Id
LEFT JOIN posts AS other ON other.Id = l.other_id
GROUP BY p.Id, p.Title
ORDER BY p.Id

        MAX(ym.Date) AS last_month
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    WHERE ym.Date >= '201301' AND ym.Date < '201401'
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID
)

    COUNT(CASE WHEN a.recorded_months > 0 THEN 1 END) AS customers_with_recorded_amount,

    SUM(a.monthly_rows - a.recorded_months) AS null_months,
    MIN(a.min_consumption) AS min_consumption,
    MIN(a.first_month) AS first_month,
    MAX(a.last_month) AS last_month
FROM customers AS c
LEFT JOIN activity AS a ON a.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.Segment

input.question: I'm preparing a partner-bank negotiation and want to focus on our big-city clients. I need a ranking of the recipient bank and counter-account pairs by the total amount paid. If two pairs tie for the largest total, list both. For each pair, give me: the recipient bank code, the recipient counter-account number, the number of outgoing payments, and the total amount paid.
input.evidence: Gold credit card means card type 'gold'; account owner means disposition type 'OWNER'; the counter-account is the partner account at another bank to which a payment is sent; the district is the one where the account's branch is located.

    SELECT a.account_id
    FROM main.account AS a
    JOIN main.district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id

    MIN(t.amount) AS minimum_debit_amount

JOIN eligible_accounts AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id

    SELECT a.account_id
    FROM main.account AS a
    JOIN main.district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) >= 250000
      AND a.account_id IN (
          SELECT dp.account_id
          FROM main.disp AS dp
          JOIN main.card AS c ON c.disp_id = dp.disp_id
          WHERE dp.type = 'OWNER' AND c.type = 'gold'
      )
)
SELECT t.operation,
       COUNT(*) AS payment_count,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN t.bank IS NULL AND t.account IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS both_missing,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN t.bank IS NULL AND t.account IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS bank_missing,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN t.bank IS NOT NULL AND t.account IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS account_missing,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN t.bank IS NOT NULL AND t.account = 0 THEN 1 END) AS bank_with_zero_account,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.bank IS NOT NULL AND t.account IS NOT NULL
                           THEN t.bank || ':' || t.account END) AS recipient_pairs
FROM main.trans AS t
JOIN eligible_accounts AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.date >= '1998-01-01'
  AND t.date < '1999-01-01'
GROUP BY t.operation

WITH issued_cards AS (
    SELECT card.card_id,
           card.issued,
           disp.client_id,
           client.birth_date,
           client.district_id AS client_district_id,
           account.district_id AS account_district_id,
           district.district_id AS matched_district_id
    FROM card
    LEFT JOIN disp ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id
    LEFT JOIN client ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
    LEFT JOIN account ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
    LEFT JOIN district ON district.district_id = client.district_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', card.issued) = '1994'
       OR substr(card.issued, 1, 4) = '1994'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS card_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT issued_cards.client_id) AS client_count,
       COUNT(issued_cards.matched_district_id) AS matched_district_count,
       SUM(issued_cards.client_district_id <> issued_cards.account_district_id) AS different_district_count,
       MIN(issued_cards.issued) AS first_issue,
       MAX(issued_cards.issued) AS last_issue,
       SUM(strftime('%Y', issued_cards.issued) IS NULL) AS unparsed_issue_count,
       SUM(strftime('%Y', issued_cards.birth_date) IS NULL) AS unparsed_birth_count
FROM issued_cards

WITH account_loans AS (
    SELECT loan.account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS loan_count,
           SUM(loan.amount) AS total_amount_borrowed
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY loan.account_id
),
cardholders AS (
    SELECT client.client_id,
           client.gender,
           client.birth_date,
           card.type AS card_type,
           CAST(strftime('%Y', card.issued) AS INTEGER)
               - CAST(strftime('%Y', client.birth_date) AS INTEGER) AS age_at_issue,
           COALESCE(account_loans.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count,
           COALESCE(account_loans.total_amount_borrowed, 0) AS total_amount_borrowed,
           district.A2 AS district_name,
           district.A11 AS district_average_salary
    FROM card
    JOIN disp ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id
    JOIN client ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
    LEFT JOIN district ON district.district_id = client.district_id
    LEFT JOIN account_loans ON account_loans.account_id = disp.account_id
    WHERE card.issued >= '1994-01-01'
      AND card.issued < '1995-01-01'
)
SELECT cardholders.client_id,
       cardholders.gender,
       cardholders.birth_date,
       cardholders.card_type,
       cardholders.age_at_issue,
       cardholders.loan_count,
       cardholders.total_amount_borrowed,
       CASE
           WHEN cardholders.loan_count > 0 AND cardholders.age_at_issue < 30 THEN 'Young borrower'
           WHEN cardholders.loan_count > 0 AND cardholders.age_at_issue >= 30 THEN 'Mature borrower'
           ELSE 'Non-borrower'
       END AS borrower_classification,
       cardholders.district_name,
       cardholders.district_average_salary,
       RANK() OVER (
           PARTITION BY cardholders.gender
           ORDER BY cardholders.age_at_issue DESC
       ) AS age_rank_within_gender
FROM cardholders
ORDER BY cardholders.client_id

WITH cardholders AS (
    SELECT
        cl.client_id,
        cl.gender,
        cl.birth_date,
        c.type AS card_type,
        CAST(strftime('%Y', c.issued) AS INTEGER)
            - CAST(strftime('%Y', cl.birth_date) AS INTEGER) AS age_at_card_issue,
        dp.account_id,
        cl.district_id
    FROM main.card AS c
    JOIN main.disp AS dp ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id
    JOIN main.client AS cl ON cl.client_id = dp.client_id
    WHERE c.issued >= '1994-01-01' AND c.issued < '1995-01-01'
),
account_loans AS (
    SELECT
        l.account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS number_of_loans,
        SUM(l.amount) AS total_amount_borrowed
    FROM main.loan AS l
    GROUP BY l.account_id
)
SELECT
    ch.client_id,
    ch.gender,
    ch.birth_date,
    ch.card_type,
    ch.age_at_card_issue,
    COALESCE(al.number_of_loans, 0) AS number_of_loans,
    COALESCE(al.total_amount_borrowed, 0) AS total_amount_borrowed,
    CASE
        WHEN al.number_of_loans > 0 AND ch.age_at_card_issue < 30 THEN 'Young borrower'
        WHEN al.number_of_loans > 0 AND ch.age_at_card_issue >= 30 THEN 'Mature borrower'
        ELSE 'Non-borrower'
    END AS borrower_classification,
    dt.A2 AS district_name,
    dt.A11 AS district_average_salary,
    RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY ch.gender
        ORDER BY ch.age_at_card_issue DESC
    ) AS age_rank_within_gender
FROM cardholders AS ch
LEFT JOIN account_loans AS al ON al.account_id = ch.account_id
LEFT JOIN main.district AS dt ON dt.district_id = ch.district_id
ORDER BY ch.client_id

arguments.sql:
WITH race AS (
    SELECT raceId, time
    FROM main.races
    WHERE year = 2017 AND name = 'Azerbaijan Grand Prix'
),
laps AS (
    SELECT l.raceId, l.driverId, l.lap, l.milliseconds,
           SUM(l.milliseconds) OVER (
               PARTITION BY l.raceId, l.driverId ORDER BY l.lap
           ) AS elapsed_ms
    FROM main.lapTimes AS l
    JOIN race ON race.raceId = l.raceId
),
pit_anchors AS (
    SELECT p.time,
           CAST(strftime('%s', p.time) AS INTEGER) * 1000 - l.elapsed_ms AS implied_start_ms
    FROM main.pitStops AS p
    JOIN laps AS l ON l.raceId = p.raceId AND l.driverId = p.driverId AND l.lap = p.lap
)
SELECT re.milliseconds AS winner_elapsed_ms,
       l.elapsed_ms AS winner_total_lap_ms,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pit_anchors) AS pit_stop_count,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pit_anchors WHERE instr(time, '.') <> 0) AS pit_stops_with_fractional_seconds,
       (SELECT strftime('%H:%M:%f', MIN(implied_start_ms) / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') FROM pit_anchors) AS earliest_implied_start,
       (SELECT strftime('%H:%M:%f', MAX(implied_start_ms) / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') FROM pit_anchors) AS latest_implied_start
FROM race
JOIN main.results AS re ON re.raceId = race.raceId
JOIN laps AS l ON l.raceId = re.raceId AND l.driverId = re.driverId AND l.lap = re.laps
WHERE re.position = 1;

department_majors AS (

FROM department_majors
GROUP BY department
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences' THEN 1 END) > 0
ORDER BY department
LIMIT -1

    SELECT MAX(e.expense_date) AS expense_date
    FROM expense AS e
    JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
    WHERE m.position = 'Vice President'
)
SELECT e.expense_date, SUM(e.cost) AS total_cost
FROM expense AS e
JOIN latest_vice_president_expense AS latest
    ON latest.expense_date = e.expense_date
GROUP BY e.expense_date
LIMIT 1

arguments.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE
period_expenses AS (
    SELECT e.link_to_member AS member_id, e.expense_description, e.cost
    FROM main.expense AS e
    WHERE e.expense_date >= '2019-10-01'
      AND e.expense_date < '2019-12-01'
),
item_parts(member_id, item, remainder) AS (
    SELECT member_id, NULL, expense_description || ','
    FROM period_expenses
    UNION ALL
    SELECT member_id,
           SUBSTR(remainder, 1, INSTR(remainder, ',') - 1),
           SUBSTR(remainder, INSTR(remainder, ',') + 1)
    FROM item_parts
    WHERE remainder <> ''
),
item_counts AS (
    SELECT member_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM(item)), '')) AS kind_count
    FROM item_parts
    GROUP BY member_id
),
spending AS (
    SELECT member_id, ROUND(SUM(cost), 2) AS total_spending_dollars
    FROM period_expenses
    GROUP BY member_id
),
ranked_members AS (
    SELECT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name,
           i.kind_count,
           s.total_spending_dollars,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY i.kind_count DESC) AS kind_rank
    FROM main.member AS m
    JOIN item_counts AS i ON i.member_id = m.member_id
    JOIN spending AS s ON s.member_id = m.member_id
)
SELECT full_name, kind_count, total_spending_dollars
FROM ranked_members
WHERE kind_rank = 1
ORDER BY full_name

arguments.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE period_expenses AS (
    SELECT e.link_to_member AS member_id,
           e.expense_description,
           e.cost
    FROM expense AS e
    WHERE e.expense_date >= '2019-10-01'
      AND e.expense_date < '2019-12-01'
),
split_items(member_id, item, remainder) AS (
    SELECT p.member_id, NULL, p.expense_description || ','
    FROM period_expenses AS p
    UNION ALL
    SELECT s.member_id,
           LOWER(TRIM(SUBSTR(s.remainder, 1, INSTR(s.remainder, ',') - 1))),
           SUBSTR(s.remainder, INSTR(s.remainder, ',') + 1)
    FROM split_items AS s
    WHERE s.remainder <> ''
),
item_counts AS (
    SELECT s.member_id, COUNT(DISTINCT s.item) AS kind_count
    FROM split_items AS s
    WHERE s.item <> ''
    GROUP BY s.member_id
),
spending AS (
    SELECT p.member_id, ROUND(SUM(p.cost), 2) AS total_spending
    FROM period_expenses AS p
    GROUP BY p.member_id
),
ranked_members AS (
    SELECT m.member_id,
           m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name,
           i.kind_count,
           s.total_spending,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY i.kind_count DESC) AS kind_rank
    FROM member AS m
    JOIN item_counts AS i ON i.member_id = m.member_id
    JOIN spending AS s ON s.member_id = m.member_id
)
SELECT r.full_name, r.kind_count, r.total_spending
FROM ranked_members AS r
WHERE r.kind_rank = 1
ORDER BY r.full_name, r.member_id

arguments.sql:
WITH power_counts AS (
    SELECT hp.hero_id, COUNT(*) AS record_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS power_count
    FROM main.hero_power AS hp
    LEFT JOIN main.superpower AS p ON p.id = hp.power_id
    GROUP BY hp.hero_id
),
names AS (
    SELECT s.id, g.gender, s.superhero_name, TRIM(s.full_name) AS full_name, pc.record_count, pc.power_count
    FROM main.superhero AS s
    JOIN main.gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
    LEFT JOIN power_counts AS pc ON pc.hero_id = s.id
    WHERE g.gender IN ('Male', 'Female')
)
SELECT gender, 'all heroes' AS category, COUNT(*) AS heroes,
       COUNT(record_count) AS heroes_with_power_records, SUM(COALESCE(power_count, 0)) AS powers,
       SUM(COALESCE(record_count - power_count, 0)) AS extra_power_records
FROM names
GROUP BY gender
UNION ALL
SELECT gender, 'space in full name', COUNT(*), COUNT(record_count), SUM(COALESCE(power_count, 0)),
       SUM(COALESCE(record_count - power_count, 0))
FROM names
WHERE full_name LIKE '% %'
GROUP BY gender
UNION ALL
SELECT gender, COALESCE(full_name, '[NULL]'), 1, record_count IS NOT NULL, COALESCE(power_count, 0),
       COALESCE(record_count - power_count, 0)
FROM names
WHERE id IN (83, 341, 410, 431, 474, 557, 586, 587, 610, 632, 673, 674, 675, 676, 730, 735, 745)
   OR (full_name NOT LIKE '% %' AND full_name GLOB '*[^a-zA-Z-]*')

WITH name_groups AS (
    SELECT g.gender, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT TRIM(s.full_name)) AS labels
    FROM main.superhero AS s
    JOIN main.gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
    WHERE g.gender IN ('Male', 'Female')
      AND INSTR(TRIM(s.full_name), ' ') = 0
    GROUP BY g.gender
),
power_quality AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS links,
           COUNT(hp.power_id) AS nonnull_links,
           COUNT(p.id) AS matched_links
    FROM main.hero_power AS hp
    LEFT JOIN main.superpower AS p ON p.id = hp.power_id
),
duplicate_links AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS duplicates
    FROM (
        SELECT hp.hero_id, hp.power_id
        FROM main.hero_power AS hp
        GROUP BY hp.hero_id, hp.power_id
        HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
    )
)
SELECT ng.gender, ng.labels, pq.links, pq.nonnull_links, pq.matched_links, dl.duplicates
FROM name_groups AS ng
CROSS JOIN power_quality AS pq
CROSS JOIN duplicate_links AS dl

WITH hero_power_counts AS (
    SELECT s.id, g.gender, COUNT(hp.power_id) AS power_count
    FROM main.superhero AS s
    JOIN main.gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
    LEFT JOIN main.hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
    WHERE g.gender IN ('Male', 'Female')
      AND INSTR(TRIM(s.full_name), ' ') > 0
      AND TRIM(s.full_name) NOT IN (
          'Anna Marie',
          'Diana of Themyscira',
          'Howard (Last name unrevealed)',
          'Krypto the Superdog',
          'Mr. Mxyzptlk',
          'Ra''s Al Ghul',
          'Weapon XI',
          'Yurrd the Unknown'
      )
      AND TRIM(s.full_name) NOT LIKE 'Cyberdyne Systems Series %'
    GROUP BY s.id, g.gender
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(power_count) FILTER (WHERE gender = 'Male'), 2) AS male_average,
       ROUND(AVG(power_count) FILTER (WHERE gender = 'Female'), 2) AS female_average
FROM hero_power_counts
LIMIT 1

input.question: I'm preparing a report on Marvel's roster and want to gauge how heroic their catalogued heroes are. Among Marvel Comics superheroes whose civilian full name is documented, what percentage are good? Please give me just that single percentage, rounded to two decimal places. Note: the percentage should be taken over all Marvel Comics superheroes with a known full name - those whose moral alignment is unknown still count toward the total, just not as good.
input.evidence: Good refers to alignment = 'Good'. A full name means the hero's real-world civilian identity, i.e. an actual person's name such as 'Charles Chandler' or 'Richard Milhouse Jones'.

arguments.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE diagnosis_entries (ID, remaining, disease) AS (
    SELECT p.ID,
           CASE
               WHEN trim(p.Diagnosis) = 'SJS  RA' THEN 'SJS,RA'
               ELSE replace(p.Diagnosis, char(29), ',')
           END || ',',
           NULL
    FROM main.Patient AS p
    WHERE instr(p.Diagnosis, 'RA') > 0
      AND instr(p.Diagnosis, 'SJS') > 0

    UNION ALL

    SELECT e.ID,
           substr(e.remaining, instr(e.remaining, ',') + 1),
           trim(substr(e.remaining, 1, instr(e.remaining, ',') - 1),
                char(9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 32))
    FROM diagnosis_entries AS e
    WHERE e.remaining <> ''
),
overlap_patients AS (
    SELECT e.ID
    FROM diagnosis_entries AS e
    WHERE e.disease <> ''
      AND e.disease NOT GLOB '* susp'
      AND e.disease NOT GLOB '* susp.'
    GROUP BY e.ID
    HAVING MAX(e.disease = 'RA') = 1
       AND MAX(e.disease = 'SJS') = 1
       AND MAX(e.disease NOT IN ('RA', 'SJS')) = 0
),
patients_with_normal_platelets AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT l.ID
    FROM main.Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.PLT > 100
      AND l.PLT < 400
)
SELECT COUNT(n.ID) AS patients_ever_normal,
       COUNT(*) - COUNT(n.ID) AS patients_never_normal
FROM overlap_patients AS p
LEFT JOIN patients_with_normal_platelets AS n ON n.ID = p.ID
LIMIT 1

WITH RECURSIVE diagnosis_tokens(patient_id, diagnosis, remaining) AS (
    SELECT Patient.ID,
           '',
           CASE trim(Patient.Diagnosis, char(9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 32))
               WHEN 'SJS  RA' THEN 'SJS,RA'
               WHEN 'RA  SJS' THEN 'RA,SJS'
               ELSE replace(Patient.Diagnosis, char(29), ',')
           END || ','
    FROM Patient
    WHERE instr(Patient.Diagnosis, 'RA') > 0
      AND instr(Patient.Diagnosis, 'SJS') > 0

    UNION ALL

    SELECT patient_id,
           trim(substr(remaining, 1, instr(remaining, ',') - 1),
                char(9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 32)),
           substr(remaining, instr(remaining, ',') + 1)
    FROM diagnosis_tokens
    WHERE remaining <> ''
),
eligible_patients AS (
    SELECT patient_id
    FROM diagnosis_tokens
    WHERE diagnosis <> ''
      AND rtrim(diagnosis, '.') NOT LIKE '% susp'
    GROUP BY patient_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT diagnosis) = 2
       AND MIN(diagnosis) = 'RA'
       AND MAX(diagnosis) = 'SJS'
),
normal_platelet_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT Laboratory.ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE Laboratory.PLT > 100
      AND Laboratory.PLT < 400
)
SELECT COUNT(normal_platelet_patients.ID) AS patients_with_normal_platelets,
       COUNT(*) - COUNT(normal_platelet_patients.ID) AS patients_without_normal_platelets
FROM eligible_patients
LEFT JOIN normal_platelet_patients
    ON normal_platelet_patients.ID = eligible_patients.patient_id
LIMIT 1

WITH requested_types(bond_type, sort_order) AS (
    VALUES ('-', 1), ('=', 2), ('#', 3)
),
bond_counts AS (
    SELECT b.bond_type, COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS bond_count
    FROM main.bond AS b
    JOIN main.molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    JOIN main.connected AS c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    JOIN main.atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN main.atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    WHERE m.label = '+'
      AND a1.element = 'c'
      AND a2.element = 'c'
      AND b.bond_type IN ('-', '=', '#')
    GROUP BY b.bond_type
)
SELECT t.bond_type, COALESCE(bc.bond_count, 0) AS bond_count
FROM requested_types AS t
LEFT JOIN bond_counts AS bc ON bc.bond_type = t.bond_type
ORDER BY t.sort_order;
